subject: general
question:
**Select the appropriate synonym for the underlined word.**

There is no need to __attack__ our guest.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Assault**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Attack **means trying to hurt or defeat somebody by using force. (बल प्रयोग करके किसी को चोट पहुँचाने या हराने की कोशिश करना)

 
 
• **For example- ***The child was attacked by a dog.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Assault **means to physically attack or harm someone. (किसी पर शारीरिक हमला करना या नुकसान पहुंचाना) 
 
 
• **For example- ***He was assaulted by a gang of robbers.*
 
 
 
• Hence, it is clear that '**Attack**' and '**Assault**' are similar in meaning.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let us look at the meaning of the other words.

 
• **Generate **means to produce or create something. (किसी चीज़ का उत्पादन या निर्माण करना)
 
• **Mark **means to indicate or make a visible impression on something. (किसी चीज़ की ओर संकेत करना या उस पर स्पष्ट प्रभाव डालना)
 
• **Adore **means to love or admire someone or something deeply. (किसी को या किसी चीज़ को गहराई से प्यार करना या उसकी प्रशंसा करना)
